title: Thai Chickpea Skillet
description: A quick and flavorful Thai-inspired skillet dish made with chickpeas, nutritious ingredients, and a hint of polish flair.

ingredients.name: nutritious oil
ingredients.notes: such as coconut or avocado oil

instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add sausage and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Remove sausage from skillet and set aside.
Add onion and garlic to skillet and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Stir in chickpeas and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Return sausage to skillet and stir to combine.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot over rice or noodles.
Garnish with chopped cilantro or scallions, if desired.
